summary: Focused i18n retest for NavigationV2 language wiring. All 6 translation keys (v2.nav.product/technology/roadmap/founder/investors/requestAccess) render correctly across tested locales (en, es, fr, ja, ar). Language switcher lists 12 languages. Regressions verified: modal opens post-switch, smooth-scroll works, localStorage persistence, html.lang updates, and ar sets dir=rtl. Mobile menu CTA translates correctly. Known scope: remaining landing-v2 sections still English — expected, not flagged.
critical_code_review_comments: NavigationV2 has two elements matching [data-testid=language-switcher-toggle] (desktop + mobile drawer). Not a bug, but tests must scope by visibility. Consider distinct testids (e.g., language-switcher-toggle-desktop / -mobile) for stricter automation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: NavigationV2 i18n verified for en/es/fr/ja/ar. Other landing-v2 sections (HeroV2, ClosingCTAV2, FooterV2, etc.) intentionally still English — follow-up i18n pass planned. Mobile CTA testid nav-mobile-cta lives inside nav-mobile-menu drawer (open hamburger first).
